memo:
EdgeHound Performance Review — June 18, 2026

Portfolio is in solid shape: +8.35% on $10K since inception, 79 closed trades, Brier score 0.26 (acceptable for prediction markets). The fund's core edge remains intact and well-identified.

SHORT_FAVORITE continues to be the franchise engine: 20W/9L, +$1,990 PnL, and the validated hypothesis on high-priced sports markets shows 73% win rate (90% CI: 59–87%). This is our alpha. The recent soccer draw markets (Portugal, Iraq, France, Austria, Algeria) are a concern — they closed at max hold with tiny losses or scratch, never resolving. These markets lack the clean binary resolution of MLB games. The feature set doesn't distinguish 'sports match outcome' from 'sports draw probability' — the draw shorts are diluting what is otherwise an excellent engine.

MOMENTUM remains disabled: 21 trades, 8 wins, -$1,019. Correct call to keep it off.

VOLUME_SPIKE is marginal: 20 trades, 8 wins, +$190. Wins are dominated by one outlier (+$479 Iran text agreement trade). Underlying hit rate ~40%. The engine is alive but not distinguishing signal from noise in geopolitical/speculative markets.

ELITE_FOLLOW is showing promise: 8 trades, 5W, +$23 net — but the $550 stake on Israel-Iran permanent peace deal is a red flag. That position ($550 at 9.85 cents) is a speculative long on a near-zero-probability event. High conviction needed here.

SMART_CONSENSUS: 1 trade, 0 wins, -$385. Disabled. Correct.

No parameter changes warranted this session. Sample sizes on VOLUME_SPIKE and ELITE_FOLLOW remain below 15 for clean segmentation. SHORT_FAVORITE is performing; don't disrupt it.
observations: SHORT_FAVORITE validated: 73% win rate on high-priced sports, CI 59–87%, dominant PnL contributor (+$1,990)
Soccer draw shorts (6 recent trades) all exited via max-hold with scratch/tiny losses — market structure differs from MLB binary outcomes, feature blind spot
MOMENTUM correctly disabled: 8/21 wins, -$1,019 cumulative, no rehabilitation signal
VOLUME_SPIKE marginally positive (+$190) but driven by one outlier; base hit rate ~40%, insufficient edge across geopolitical markets
ELITE_FOLLOW improving: 5/8 wins, but $550 stake on Israel-Iran permanent peace deal at 9.85 cents is outsized for a near-zero resolution probability
Open book is baseball-heavy and well-structured; $3,101 staked against ~$10,835 equity (~28.6% deployed), within limits
Brier score 0.26 — model is somewhat miscalibrated; predicted pPredicted values often 0.57–0.68 on SHORT_FAVORITE entries where true edge is structural, not probabilistic
SMART_CONSENSUS remains correctly disabled; single trade, -$385, no recovery path
No parameter changes warranted: insufficient new settled trades since last adjustment to justify noise-chasing
changeReasoning: No changes. SHORT_FAVORITE is performing well and parameters are calibrated for it. VOLUME_SPIKE and ELITE_FOLLOW have insufficient settled trades (<15 clean segments) to justify tuning. The soccer draw market blind spot is a signal-selection issue, not a parameter issue — flagged for human review on market type filtering. Raising kellyMult or maxExposure without cleaner edge evidence on secondary engines would increase variance without improving EV. Hold steady.
riskFlags: CRITICAL: $550 ELITE_FOLLOW stake on 'Israel x Iran permanent peace deal by June 30' at 9.85 cents — this is a near-impossibility; position sizing is disproportionate to realistic resolution probability, manual review recommended

Soccer draw market SHORT_FAVORITEs are structurally different from MLB match outcomes — draws are not binary favorites, and the model appears to be misapplying the sports edge to a different market type; consider filtering draw markets from SHORT_FAVORITE eligibility
VOLUME_SPIKE geopolitical trades (Iran enrichment, Hormuz fees, Algeria win) show consistent stop-loss exits — engine may be reacting to news-driven volume that lacks directional predictive value
Brier 0.26 with 79 model updates suggests systematic overconfidence; predicted win probabilities on SHORT_FAVORITE entries (0.62–0.69) may be inflating Kelly stake sizes relative to true edge

configNow.comment: EdgeHound tunable parameters. The AI Analyst may adjust these within hard rails enforced in code. Humans can edit too. [pMin lowered to match surviving engines after momentum block]
